support.prompt:
💬 Write your question here

Send one text message and I will pass it to the administrator. Their reply will arrive in this chat. Up to 3,000 characters; photos and files are not forwarded. Do not send passwords, card details or eSIM codes.

/cancel — cancel. Menu buttons and other commands also cancel your request. You have 30 minutes to send it.
support.payment_prompt:
💬 What happened with your payment or order?

Describe the issue in one message. Include the order number if you have it. I will pass your message to the administrator, and their reply will arrive here. Up to 3,000 characters; photos and files are not forwarded. Do not send passwords, card details or eSIM codes.

/cancel — cancel. Menu buttons and other commands also cancel your request. You have 30 minutes to send it.
support.admin_help: You are the support administrator. Customer requests arrive in this chat. To answer, use Reply on the request and send your text. Use /support to try the support flow with your own account.
support.admin_preview:
💬 You are the administrator — try support

Send one text message here. I will deliver it to you as a test customer request. Then use Reply on that request to test the response. Real customer requests also arrive here.

Up to 3,000 characters, without files or secrets. /cancel — cancel. Menu buttons and other commands also cancel the test; it is available for 30 minutes.
support.preview_sent: ✅ Test request delivered — see above. Use Reply on it to test the response. Customers use support in the same way.
support.unavailable: In-bot support is temporarily unavailable. Please try /support again later.
support.cancelled: Support mode closed. Your next message will not be forwarded. Use /start for the menu.
support.text_only: Please send one text message of 1–{0} characters. Files and captions are not forwarded. Use /cancel to exit.
support.send_failed: Your message could not be delivered. It has not been confirmed as sent. Try sending it again, or use /cancel to exit.
support.sent: ✅ Your message was sent to support. The reply will arrive here. Use /support for another question.
support.reply_invalid: This message cannot be answered. Use Reply on the customer request itself. It must have arrived within the last 7 days and not have been answered yet.
support.reply_failed: The reply could not be delivered. Try again: use Reply on the original request and send your answer once more.
support.reply_sent: ✅ Your reply was delivered to the customer.
support.external_option: An additional support channel is also available below. You can still send your next text message here.
support.terms_builtin:
eSIM purchase terms and privacy

Before payment, check the package’s coverage, data allowance, validity and activation rule. Your device must support eSIM and be carrier-unlocked. Installation and first network connection are different activation rules; the package card specifies which applies. Network availability and speed depend on the local operator and conditions.

The final price is shown in Telegram Stars (XTR) before payment. By confirming compatibility and the terms, you request the selected digital package. After successful payment and supplier processing, the bot sends the eSIM QR and manual installation code here. Issuance may take time; /orders shows the status. Do not install the same profile on multiple devices or delete an installed profile before checking the package rules.

The bot queues refunds for payment errors or extra charges it detects. Support can refund a paid order before it has been submitted to the supplier. If supplier submission is uncertain, or a profile has been issued or activated, contact /paysupport: the case requires verification, and a refund is not promised or automatically ruled out. Never pay again merely because issuance is taking time.

We store the Telegram user ID, language, order and payment identifiers, package, amount and status needed to deliver and reconcile purchases. Activation codes are encrypted in the database. If you enter support mode, only your next voluntary text is sent to the administrator; the bot does not store ticket text in its database. Temporary reply routes expire within 7 days. Messages remain in Telegram according to its policies. Use /support to ask about your data or request deletion; records needed for unresolved payments or applicable retention obligations may need to be kept.

/support — general help and privacy requests
/paysupport — payments, issuance and refunds
